title: Session file
description: How the hooks and the mod find the session process (AD-5; design decision 3): written 0600 in the session folder as <key>.json, where key is the PID of the Claude Code process, parent of the session process and of every hook. A file that fails validation, or names another format major, is no session: its reader treats the session process as unreachable.

format.description: The session file format, as major.minor. A reader supports major 1 and accepts any of its minors; a minor only adds optional fields, written only once every reader accepts them.

key.description: The Claude Code process's PID, which names the file.

pid.description: The session process's PID: a file whose process is gone is stale.

apiAddress.description: The local API's socket, an absolute path within Linux's 107 bytes; on macOS the session process checks the smaller limit before it listens.

sessionToken.description: The local API's token: 128 random bits as base64url, written as a board token is, though it opens no board.

projectDir.description: The session project root, the real path of CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (AD-12); absent when the session has none, as when the variable is not set.
